title: Find your NHS number
description: Use this service to get your NHS number sent to you by text, email or letter.
body:
Use this service to get your NHS number. Your NHS number is a 10 digit number, like 999 123 4567.

Who can use this service

You can use this service for: - yourself, if you are registered with a GP in England - someone else, if they are registered with a GP in England

How you will get your NHS number

Depending on the details your GP has, you can choose to get your NHS number by: - email - text message - letter If you are using this service for someone else, they will be sent their NHS number.

Other ways to get your NHS number

You can also find your NHS number: - on any letter from the NHS - by asking your GP surgery - in the NHS App - by logging into your NHS account through the NHS website

Before you start

You will need your: - full name - date of birth - postcode of the address you used to register with your GP surgery

About using this service
